title: Incoming Students at Given Site
description: Incoming Students at Given Site - Gives a list of students enrolled at a given site. You must replace XX with your site number.
code: LIST STU STU.ID STU.LN STU.FN STU.NG? STU.SC? STU.NS? IF STU.NS = XX AND STU.NS # '' AND STU.NG # "13"  OR  STU.TG = "*"
